maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost isolated row contains four distinct spots situated approximately 1.5 to 2.0 spot-diameters superior to the primary dense row, following a slightly convex arc parallel to the upper labial margin.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 85-90% melanin saturation. The rhinarium displays dense black pigmentation across the apex and wings, with minor depigmented (pink) pixel clusters visible at the base of the nostrils and along the central philtrum line.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density aggregation of Diptera (flies) localized on the nasal bridge, medial canthus regions, and maxillary whisker pads.
